name: AI21 Labs
description: AI21 Labs builds the Jamba family of hybrid SSM-Transformer models with long context windows, offered via its own API with per-token pricing.

name: Cloudflare Workers AI
description: Cloudflare Workers AI runs open models (Llama, Qwen, Mistral, Gemma, GPT-OSS, plus embeddings and speech) on Cloudflare's global edge network, billed per token in USD (also denominated in Neurons).

name: CodeBuddy
description: Tencent's coding assistant. CodeBuddy and the WorkBuddy desktop agent bill against one shared credit balance, so a subscription covers both.

name: DeepInfra
description: DeepInfra is a serverless inference marketplace running open models (Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, GLM, Kimi and more) on managed GPUs, billed per token with no idle cost — among the cheapest hosted open-model APIs.

name: Fireworks AI
description: Fireworks AI is a high-performance serverless inference platform for open and open-weight frontier models (DeepSeek, GLM, Qwen, Kimi, MiniMax, GPT-OSS), offering Standard and Priority throughput tiers with cached-input discounts.

name: GitHub Copilot
description: GitHub's coding assistant, sold only as a subscription. Billing moved from premium requests to AI credits, published at 1 credit = $0.01 USD.

name: Meshs One
description: Meshs One is an AI API gateway connecting developers to 200+ models (including DeepSeek, GLM, Qwen, MiniMax, Kimi and Claude/GPT) through a unified API. One key, one billing pipeline. No markup on Chinese models.

name: Novita AI
description: Novita AI is an open-model inference aggregator with an OpenAI-compatible API, hosting DeepSeek, Llama, Qwen, GLM, Kimi and MiniMax models with per-token pricing and prompt caching.

name: OpenCode
description: OpenCode sells access to the same models two ways. Zen is a pay-per-token API gateway for the OpenCode coding agent, carrying GPT, Claude, Gemini and Grok alongside open models (Qwen, DeepSeek, MiniMax, GLM, Kimi) — several of them free for a limited time. OpenCode Go is a $10/month subscription over the open models only, with its allowance published in dollars of usage.

name: Qoder
description: Alibaba Cloud's coding assistant, renamed from 通义灵码 (Lingma) on 2026-05-20 and repriced onto a Credits quota the same day.

name: Runway
description: Runway builds frontier video-generation models (Gen-4, Aleph) plus hosted partner models (Veo, Seedance), billed per second of generated video via its API.

name: SambaNova Cloud
description: SambaNova Cloud runs open models (DeepSeek, Llama, Qwen) on custom RDU hardware for record-fast token throughput, billed per token.

name: StepFun
description: StepFun (阶跃星辰) is a Chinese AI lab building the Step series of multimodal foundation models (text, vision and audio), offered via its own API with per-token pricing and prompt caching.

name: TRAE
description: ByteDance's AI IDE. Paid tiers currently sell queue priority (速通) rather than an allowance; a credit-based plan was announced for 2026-07-30.
